mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds regardless of monetary policy stance and is consistently observable across historical data.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20d forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and returns is not negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25% over the past month signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%), or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 5d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The joint movement is required for the signal.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing recovery regime (HOUST > 750 and RSAFS > 380), rising housing starts and consumer spending signal strong economic demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The regime condition must be met for the signal to activate.
failure_condition: In the housing recovery regime (HOUST > 750 and RSAFS > 380), SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This effect is consistent across all economic cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO against 60d forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and returns is not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing start rate (HOUST) above 800,000 units signals strong consumer demand for housing, which stimulates related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal activates when housing starts exceed this threshold.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST > 800, or the Rank IC for HOUST against 5d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3% annually), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. Both conditions must be met for the signal.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5 and CPIAUCSL > 3, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The joint movement is required for the signal to activate.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST up and RSAFS up) fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
